message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish a hand and by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0), plus two “Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two” cards. There are also 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four” cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” card changes direction). On your turn you must play one card from your hand that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card, or play a Wild card. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” If you forget and another player catches you before the next player takes their turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Hand** | The first player to discard all of their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner gets points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• Add those points to the winner’s total. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the agreed‑upon score (commonly 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – It gives you more options to play. 2. **Save Wild Draw Four** – Use it when you’re sure you have no matching color or number. 3. **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls** – They’re a good hint about what cards they might still hold. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a Wild Draw Four if you’re sure the player had a playable card. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
